description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data already imported for MSFT (Microsoft Corp.) covering January 2023 through December 2024 (502 trading days from Yahoo Finance).

A quantitative analyst needs to find the optimal moving average crossover parameters for MSFT by running a parameter optimization sweep. This is a common workflow for systematic traders who want to determine which parameter combinations produce the best risk-adjusted returns.

Your task: Use the Strategy Analyzer's optimization feature to test the built-in SampleMACrossOver strategy on MSFT with daily bars over the full available date range. Configure the optimization to sweep:
- Fast moving average period: from 5 to 20, step size 5 (i.e., test values 5, 10, 15, 20)
- Slow moving average period: from 30 to 60, step size 10 (i.e., test values 30, 40, 50, 60)

Run the optimization and, once complete, export the optimization results grid to a file at:
  C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\NinjaTraderTasks\msft_optimization_results.csv

Login credentials: Docker / GymAnything123!
